segment_null_observation: For each eligible calibration phase segment, compute excursion amplitude for the observed segment and every accepted same-transformation null realization. Use the maximum amplitude across those realizations as one segment-level null observation. Variants never become independent pseudo-observations.

accepted_null_realizations.observed_path: Always included after route state certification; its inclusion is conservative because an unobserved human detour in calibration can only raise the null envelope.
accepted_null_realizations.commutation_representation: Adjacent opposite-face swaps and deterministic opposite-face canonicalization are included only after exact KTransformation equality to the original phase segment is verified.
accepted_null_realizations.solver_alternative: cubing.js experimentalSolve3x3x3IgnoringCenters is run on the relative phase endpoint. Inverted solve is included in the primary envelope only when its full KTransformation is exactly identical to the observed phase transformation. Physically-equivalent-but-not-exact alternatives are reported diagnostically but excluded from the primary null threshold.
accepted_null_realizations.other_representation: Any rotation/wide/slice rewrite may be added only if exact KTransformation equality is programmatically verified and the rewrite rule was encoded before null values are read.

threshold_hierarchy: method×phase 99th percentile when n>=40 segment-level envelope observations
quantile_rule: nearest-rank upper empirical quantile: sorted values, index ceil(q*n)-1, so threshold never interpolates downward between observed null amplitudes
candidate_requires: amplitude strictly greater than frozen algorithm-null threshold
return to or below the pre-excursion frontier occurs strictly before the final phase move
